page_title: AUG 0-0 WER | Augsburg v Werder Bremen 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+8' Golden opportunity! Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

90+7' Crossbar! Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!
90+5' Today's referee Tobias Welz rightly decides to book Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) for his harsh tackle.
90+4' Tobias Welz shows the yellow card to Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) for a heavy challenge.
90+2' Substitution. Han-Noah Massengo will be replaced by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
90+2' Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+1' That's unlucky! Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
90+1' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
89' Augsburg win a corner.
88' Aiman Dardari (Augsburg) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. Augsburg win a corner kick.
87' Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
86' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

85' Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. Augsburg have a free kick.
83' Horst Steffen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) replacing Isaac Schmidt.
83' A substitution has been made. Niklas Stark is replaced by Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen).
82' The goal by Augsburg is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
81' Possible change! There could be a foul by the attacking team in the lead up. Referee Tobias Welz wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
80' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Tobias Welz due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) and his team.
78' Fabian Rieder goes off the pitch and Aiman Dardari (Augsburg) comes on.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
76' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) hits the left post with a rebound from just outside the box.
75' The attendance for today's match is 30000.
75' The substitution has been made. Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) has replaced Cameron Puertas.
74' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) sees a yellow card from Tobias Welz after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
72' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Werder Bremen earn a free kick.
72' Corner kicks – 4:10.
68' That will be all from Justin Njinmah who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marco Grull (Werder Bremen).
67' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
67' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

66' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) for a tough tackle.
64' Augsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
63' Mert Komur (Augsburg) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
58' The ratio of the ball possession is 47:53.
56' Kristijan Jakic is being substituted because of an injury. Manuel Baum sends Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) on the pitch.
56' That's the end of the game for Dimitrios Giannoulis, who is replaced by Mads Pedersen (Augsburg).
54' The ball goes behind for a corner. Augsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
52' PENALTY APPEAL by Augsburg, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

52' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Mio Backhaus.

51' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
50' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

48' A wild pass somehow finds Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Manuel Baum probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Marius Wolf. He is replaced by Mert Komur (Augsburg).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Tobias Welz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Booking. Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) receives a caution from the referee.
45+4' Tobias Welz has issued a yellow card to Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg).
45+1' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Neat passing move from Augsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
41' The ball is out of play and Werder Bremen manage to earn a corner.
40' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
40' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Welz blows for a foul. Werder Bremen will take a free kick near the side line.
40' Corner kick. Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is ready to send the ball into the box.
39' Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
35' Werder Bremen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
35' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Werder Bremen force their opponents to concede a corner.
33' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is able to continue to play.
29' The game is interrupted now, Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
26' The ball goes out of play and Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Augsburg earn a corner.
24' 1:5 – the corner kicks stats.
22' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) commits a foul and Tobias Welz immediately signals a free kick. Augsburg have been awarded a free kick.
21' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is caught offside!
20' It's going to be a corner kick.
20' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Augsburg can continue in their attacking effort.
18' A clumsy foul by Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) and Tobias Welz blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Augsburg.
18' The linesman points to the corner flag, Werder Bremen are going to take it.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jens Stage (Werder Bremen). Now Werder Bremen have a corner.
16' The Augsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' Corner kick. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity.
12' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
11' Tobias Welz blows the whistle, Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) is penalised for a foul. That's a free kick to Werder Bremen.
10' Great chance! Marius Wolf (Augsburg) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
10' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

9' Werder Bremen slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

9' Mio Backhaus makes a good save! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a low shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
7' Werder Bremen will take a corner kick.
6' The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen will have a chance to score from a corner.
4' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Augsburg get a free kick.
3' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
1' It looks like Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Welz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Augsburg have a free kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Tobias Welz.
